name: Refract
summary: ReShade shader that generates a Looking Glass quilt from a game's depth buffer. Uses Single-View Depth Reprojection to synthesize the multiple camera angles required for a lightfield quilt. Works downstream of any game that exposes a depth buffer to ReShade — no dedicated stereo pipeline required.
compatibility_notes: Requires depth buffer access via ReShade — does not work with DX12 or Vulkan in most configurations. Quilt quality depends on depth buffer accuracy. Does not produce true Multi-View Rendering — synthesised views have the same artifacts as depth reprojection (haloing, stair-stepping, incorrect UI depth). For best quilt results, use a native stereo pipeline (Geo-11, UEVR) as input if available.
